coverage.headline: Keyrock acquires BlockFills trading assets in institutional crypto expansion
coverage.summary: Keyrock completed its acquisition of BlockFills' institutional trading and brokerage assets for $3.25 million following court approval of the Chapter 11 sale. The deal adds institutional client relationships, derivatives trading technology, regulatory licenses (CIMA/Cayman, pending FCA/UK), and several senior BlockFills executives to Keyrock.

coverage.headline: Keyrock closes deal for BlockFills' institutional trading and brokerage assets
coverage.summary: Keyrock announced completion of its acquisition of BlockFills' institutional trading and brokerage operations for $3.25 million out of Chapter 11 bankruptcy, gaining proprietary technology, institutional client relationships, and regulatory licenses.

coverage.headline: Crypto Firm BlockFills Gets OK For $3.25M Ch. 11 Sale
coverage.summary: A Delaware bankruptcy judge approved the $3.25 million sale of BlockFills' assets to Belgian digital asset firm Keyrock as the debtor simultaneously prepared for a Chapter 11 plan confirmation hearing.
